echo '@@ FILTERED_LOG_72717_72723'
/usr/bin/vlogutil -v kerneltime -s --start-from=72717 --end-to=72723 | awk '/[Mm]ute|[Pp][Vv][Cc][Cc]|QD_TCON_OFF|ERR DET|RT Protect|TCON ERR|Tcon Power|Set Suspend Flag|sensing|Sensing/ {print}'
echo '@@ TIME_END'; date -u +%s; cat /proc/uptime

echo '@@ COMPLETE_FILTERED_LOG_ONLY'
